messages:
maria-marketing: quick ask — we need a concise customer one-pager + an internal field playbook for enterprise prospects (security, SLAs, deployment modes). goal: enable AE/SE to close proof-of-concept fast and route inbound MQLs correctly. deadline: draft by EOD wed, final by next tue. who can own copy + tech bullets?
josh-product: can take lead on the customer-facing one-pager. will pull from product brief + perf bench. need SE bullets for deploy options + SLA numbers from Sam.
aniya-sales: I can own the field playbook (routing map, objections, talk tracks). please add a short checklist for inbound qualification: compliance reqs, throughput targets, data residency, preferred deployment mode. also include an explicit escalation path to renewals/enterprise-sdr.
sam-se: adding technical bullets. quick notes: Hosted API: fastest time-to-value, standard SLA 99.9% with burst. Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, 99.95% SLO under commit; useful for sustained high throughput. Private (VPC/on-prem): for regulated customers, integrates with KMS/HSM, audit logs, longer lead time for provisioning. Also call out quantization/latency tradeoffs and KV cache benefits for cost.
linda-legal: a reminder — customer-facing doc can't promise anything beyond our legal SLA. phrase SLAs as "typical SLOs" and call out that enterprise contracts will specify exact SLA/penalties. also standard privacy blurb required for private deployments. I'll paste the approved wording soon.
maria-marketing: good — format plan: top half: customer one-pager (value props + short decision matrix: performance vs isolation vs time-to-value). bottom half: quick checklist + 3 callouts (security, SLA, onboarding). internal playbook: 1 pager routing map, 1 pager objections & demo checklist.
sam-se: sharing a short demo copy block you can drop into the customer pg:```
Why Redwood Inference
• Predictable inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments
• SLA-backed Dedicated capacity for mission-critical workloads (typical 99.95% SLO under commit)
• Private deployment options for regulatory controls: VPC, KMS/HSM, and audit logging
Quick fit questions: expected rps, p95 latency target, must-have compliance (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA), data residency
```
aniya-sales: routing map idea: inbound → qualify via MQL form fields (region, compliance, throughput) → if "compliance=YES" route to AE/SE + legal + solutions-eng; if "throughput>500rps" flag for Dedicated; if "air-gapped" flag to private-deploy track and slow-roll provisioning. add a short play: "If unsure, tag @sam-se and select 'SE consult' in CRM."
maria-marketing: love that. can we include a 1-line benchmark blurb? something like: "Sample benchmark: 10k tokens/sec on Dedicated A100x2 with quantization profile v2 — see Redwood bench pack." keep it non-specific.
josh-product: yep — non-specific and link to internal bench repo: https://redwood-internal/benchmarks (SEs only). also include a short note on fallback policies: route to compatible model variants when capacity constrained.
linda-legal: approved privacy snippet: "Customer data processed per contract; Redwood does not use customer prompt data to train models unless explicitly agreed in writing." include KMS/HSM mention for private deployments.
maria-marketing: timeline check — josh: draft customer one-pager by EOD wed. aniya: draft field playbook (2 pages) by EOD wed. sam: drop SE bullets + 1-line benchmark + any config snippet by EOD tmr. linda: approve privacy/SLA wording by Fri. I'll assemble and circulate for review Mon morning.
deploy-bot: deployment-notes: reminder to link any public assets to the marketing-assets repo `marketing/assets/enterprise` after final approval.
aniya-sales: tagging ops: @sam-se will you add a short demo checklist item: "Run 5-min perf smoke with sample workload, verify KV cache warmup, confirm 95th pct latency < SLA target"?
sam-se: done — will add to the playbook and include a tiny command sample for SEs (psuedo): `run_smoke_test --model x --seq 1024 --clients 5`.
maria-marketing: perfect. anyone want to volunteer to own the final upload and shareable link? i'll volunteer if no objections.
josh-product: go for it, maria. i'll review for technical accuracy.
aniya-sales: thanks — i'll prep an inbound form update in HubSpot to capture the routing flags.
linda-legal: will post the legal blurb to the doc comments by Fri AM.
maria-marketing: thanks team — i'll stitch and ping when the draft is ready. :raised_hands:
